research_question: Owned-page scope: Law Firm SEO Statistics for Organic Lead Reporting. Planned sources and method: Consented Search Console and intake records; join at aggregate channel level. Build a source-labelled comparison covering legal organic search traffic and attorney SEO leads; record dates, definitions and sample limits. Sources are proposed, not verified findings.

research_brief.purpose: Show which SEO measures belong at each funnel stage, how to read public organic benchmarks, and how to join Search Console with intake data safely.
research_brief.audience: Managing partners, marketing leads, and intake managers at U.S. law firms reviewing organic search performance.
research_brief.data_period: Ruler Analytics 2026 benchmark (with 2025 table values); Clio 2024 secret-shopper study; Google Search Console documentation current October 2026
research_brief.scope_limitations: Public sources only. No consented Search Console or intake sample was available, so the tracker plan for a first-party join is not met and the article says so.

content_gaps: Few pages assign each SEO metric to a funnel stage with its limits.
No reviewed page warns against reading Ruler 2025 and 2026 values as a controlled trend.
No reviewed page shows a privacy-safe join of Search Console and intake data.
No reviewed page pairs SEO reporting with intake response evidence.
